content.short: OHM, the token at the heart of Olympus, is supported by a treasury the protocol owns and steered by monetary policy set onchain.
content.description: OlympusDAO launched OHM in 2021 and helped popularise protocol-owned liquidity, meaning the treasury owns its trading liquidity rather than renting it from farmers. Holders can stake OHM or borrow against it through Cooler Loans, which charge a low fixed rate and cannot be liquidated on price moves. OHM holders vote on how the treasury is managed. Newer features include convertible deposits, a yield repurchase facility, range bound stability and a cross-chain bridge, audited over the years by firms such as Spearbit, Guardian and Nethermind.
